settings.video_upload_desc: Media enables Telegram previews for MP4, M4V, and MOV. Protected videos always use File.

settings.clear_local_cache_desc: Remove cached previews and temp files
settings.clear_cache_desc: This will remove all cached previews and temporary files. Your uploaded files on Telegram are not affected.
settings.clear_transcode_message: This will delete all transcoded HLS variants and cached originals. Files will need to be re-transcoded for HLS playback.
settings.ffmpeg_required_title: FFmpeg is needed for HLS playback

settings.ffmpeg_restart_hint: Install a Windows build, add the folder containing ffmpeg.exe to PATH, then restart Telegram Drive.
settings.check_updates_desc: Check if a newer version exists
settings.update_prod_only_toast: Update check is only available in production builds
settings.revoke_link_desc: Are you sure you want to revoke this link? Anyone using it will no longer be able to download the file.
settings.regenerate_api_key_desc: This will revoke your current API key and generate a new one. Any existing integrations will stop working.
settings.generate_api_key_desc: Generate a new API key for authenticating REST API requests.
settings.restart_app_toast: Restart the app for this change to take effect
settings.reconnect_success_toast: Reconnected successfully with new proxy settings
settings.encryption_unavailable: Encryption is not available in this build.
settings.encryption_backend_error: The encryption service did not respond. You may be running an older or stale app process.
settings.encryption_safety_pause_title: Encrypted transfers are paused for safety
settings.encryption_safety_pause_body: Standard transfers remain available. Encrypted uploads and decryption are disabled while the corrected file format and persistent vault are completed.
settings.encryption_disabled: Encryption is turned off. Standard transfers remain available.
settings.encryption_experimental_inventory_one: One experimental encrypted file is indexed locally. Its ciphertext has been preserved.
settings.encryption_experimental_inventory_other: {{count}} experimental encrypted files are indexed locally. Their ciphertext has been preserved.
settings.encryption_disclaimer_body: Telegram Drive cannot recover or reset forgotten passphrases, encryption keys, or recovery material. If you lose every credential that can unlock a file, that file may become permanently inaccessible. Store recovery material securely, keep a verified backup, and never share credentials with anyone you do not trust.
settings.encryption_disclaimer_acknowledgement: I understand that I am responsible for safeguarding my encryption credentials, and that losing every valid credential may permanently prevent access to my encrypted files.
settings.encryption_ack_required: Please acknowledge the encryption key-loss warning before creating a vault.
settings.default_upload_protection_desc: Choose how new files are protected by default
settings.protect_metadata_desc: Hide original filename and MIME type
settings.lock_on_sleep_desc: Lock vault when app enters background
settings.temp_plaintext_policy_desc: Strict mode blocks temp files on disk
settings.vault_create_prompt: Create a vault to enable encrypted uploads. Choose a strong passphrase you can remember.
settings.recovery_key_warning: Store this key securely. It cannot be recovered if lost.
settings.vault_is_unlocked: Vault is unlocked. Files can be encrypted and decrypted.
settings.vault_is_locked: Vault is locked. Unlock to access encrypted files.
settings.min_passphrase_length: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters
settings.export_recovery_desc: Create an encrypted backup of your vault key. Keep this bundle safe.
settings.bundle_warning: Store this bundle securely. It contains your encrypted vault key. Never share it.
settings.import_recovery_desc: Restore your vault from an encrypted recovery bundle.
settings.import_recovery_confirmation: Importing a recovery bundle will replace the current vault after the bundle and passphrase are verified. Continue?

syncPreview.setup_description: Choose what moves between your local folder and Telegram, then inspect the plan before saving.
syncPreview.backup_description: Local files upload to Telegram. Telegram-only files stay there, and nothing is downloaded into your local folder.
syncPreview.download_description: Telegram files download into your local folder. Local-only files stay there, and nothing is uploaded.
syncPreview.two_way_description: Changes can travel in either direction. Conflicting copies stay untouched until you resolve them.
syncPreview.version_notice: Replacing a file keeps the latest copy. This mapping does not retain version history or replace an independent backup.
syncPreview.delete_upload: Also delete Telegram copies when their local source is deleted
syncPreview.delete_download: Also delete local copies when their Telegram source is deleted
syncPreview.deletion_guard: A run that would delete more than half the tracked files is always stopped for review.
syncPreview.ignore_help: One pattern per line, such as *.tmp, .git/ or node_modules/. * matches any characters; ? matches one character. A trailing / excludes a folder.
syncPreview.pause_conflicts: Pause the whole mapping while conflicts need review
syncPreview.pause_conflicts_help: When off, other files can continue while conflicted files stay untouched.
syncPreview.pause_conditions: Mappings also pause when the local folder is unavailable, Telegram cannot be reached, the required vault is locked, or the account changes.
syncPreview.global_paused: Automatic sync is currently paused. Saved mappings remain idle until you enable it.
syncPreview.preview_timestamp: Previewed {{time}}. Each automatic run scans again, so later changes can alter the plan.
syncPreview.preview_required: Preview the current settings before saving this mapping.

storage.title: Device storage
storage.description: Review what is stored on this device and reclaim disposable copies.
storage.free_unknown: Available device space could not be read.
storage.accounting: Sizes are file bytes, measured when you refresh. They exclude filesystem overhead, databases and settings. Kept files and workspace previews belong to this account; older caches and conversions are device-wide. Downloads include existing files recorded by this account’s desktop transfer history or published by this app in Android’s Downloads collection. Older Android versions may not expose a reliable total.
storage.cache_explanation: Clearing a cache leaves its Telegram original available. Kept files stay on the device until you remove them from Offline packs or Library.
storage.limit_explanation: Preview and thumbnail allowances are shared by the app’s cache systems. Limits are applied to future cache use; clear a category below to reclaim existing files now.
storage.clear_description: This will reclaim up to {{size}} of disposable data. Active work can change this amount.
storage.cleared: Cache cleared. Storage sizes have been refreshed.
storage.error: Storage could not be updated. Wait for active work to finish, then try again.
storage.busy: Active conversions must finish before their cache can be cleared.
storage.staging_note: Resumable camera uploads, active transfers and offline-pack staging are protected. Only verified abandoned preview staging can be reclaimed here.

offlinePacks.title: Offline trip packs
offlinePacks.description: Keep a complete selection on this device before you travel.
offlinePacks.name: Pack name
offlinePacks.select_files: Select files or a whole collection in your library to create a pack.
offlinePacks.expiry_note: Expired packs are removed while the app is running or the next time you open it.
offlinePacks.ready_note: Ready files open from this device without contacting Telegram.
offlinePacks.resume_note: Completed files survive restarting the app. Interrupted files retry from the beginning.
offlinePacks.low_space: There is not enough free space for this selection. You can create the pack now and free space before downloading.
offlinePacks.protected_note: Protected files remain visible as unavailable; export them from your unlocked vault before travelling.
offlinePacks.remove_description: This removes the pack’s downloaded copies. Telegram originals and other packs stay available.
offlinePacks.waiting_storage: Waiting for more free device storage
offlinePacks.network_unknown: The active network could not be verified. Check your connection and retry.
offlinePacks.error: The pack could not be updated. Retry after checking the account, connection and device storage.

cleanup.title: Review and clean up
cleanup.description: Compare possible duplicates or review large and old files. Open any file and check its original folder before scheduling removal.
cleanup.possible_only: These files share a name and size. Their contents have not been verified as identical. Review them individually; nothing is selected automatically.
cleanup.no_candidates: No matching files in your scanned library.
cleanup.retention_explanation: Files remain in their original Telegram folders during the recovery period and are hidden from this workspace. Restore cancels the scheduled removal. After the deadline, the app permanently deletes the verified original when this account is connected. No additional copy is kept.
cleanup.acknowledge: I understand that restoration stops once permanent deletion begins after the recovery period.
cleanup.file_changed: The original changed. It has been preserved; restore it and review again.
cleanup.waiting_network: Waiting for Telegram confirmation. Pending removals can be restored; permanent removals already in progress may be irreversible.
cleanup.error: The cleanup operation could not finish. Unverified originals are preserved.
